title: Chronic Kidney Disease Longitudinal Care Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Track eGFR and albuminuria longitudinally and risk-stratify progression rather than reacting only to single results.
Optimize blood pressure, diabetes control, and kidney-protective therapy while reviewing nephrotoxic exposure.
Escalate referral when progressive decline, refractory electrolyte issues, or advanced-stage CKD emerges.

title: Heart Failure Longitudinal Pathway Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Use structured titration and monitoring plans so guideline-directed therapy is advanced deliberately over time.
Track symptoms, weights, renal function, and potassium after medication changes instead of waiting for crisis visits.
Escalate when recurrent admissions, hypotension, or persistent congestion signal failure of routine outpatient control.

title: Diabetes Longitudinal Care Pathway Guidance
recommendation_blocks: Manage diabetes as a longitudinal program with scheduled HbA1c review, renal surveillance, retinal screening, and foot risk review.
Adjust therapy based on cardiovascular, renal, pregnancy, and hypoglycemia context rather than glucose values alone.
Close care gaps proactively when screening or complication-prevention milestones are overdue.
